instruction: Candid action photograph of an indoor gym with training racks. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt and black leggings (R4) stands in a defensive stance with his hands raised, looking at his opponent. On the right, the man in the black t-shirt and dark shorts (R1) lunges forward, throwing a punch toward R4. In the center background, the man in the background (R2) watches them, wearing a black t-shirt and patterned shorts. Bright overhead spotlighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the white floor mat.
